$comment: Hand-verified corrections merged over what scripts/import-manual.js infers.
Every entry here was read against the programming manual by a human, because
the manual is not machine-clean: it contains a wrong command name, one command
printed without its parentheses, a command whose only description sits in a
later paragraph, and ranges that depend on the robot revision.
Keys are instruction names. Fields replace the generated ones; `params`
replaces the whole list. Re-running the import preserves everything here.

SetCartAngVel.remarks: The manual prints this command's syntax as SetCartAngAcc(w), which is a documentation error: the command is SetCartAngVel and it sets an angular velocity, not an acceleration.

GetCollisionStatus.remarks: The manual prints this command without parentheses. It is listed here with the empty argument list used by every other data request command.

ActivateRobot.description: Activate all motors and release the joint brakes.

params.name: e
params.description: Force a re-initialization of the drives (1). Homing is then required again.

ActivateRobot.remarks: The manual gives no syntax block for this command; the optional argument is described in its Arguments section.

SetRealTimeMonitoring.description: Select which real-time data sets are transmitted over the monitoring port.

params.name: n
params.description: A data set, given either as a numeric code (for example 2201) or by name (for example TargetCartPos). Use All to enable every data set.

SetRealTimeMonitoring.remarks: Give either numeric codes or names, never a mix of the two in one call.

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of the R3 top rated joint velocities.

SetJointVel.remarks: The upper bound depends on the robot revision: 100 on a Meca500 R3, 150 on an R4. The wider bound is used here so that R4 programs are not flagged.

SetJointVelLimit.description: Override the default upper bound on joint velocities.

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of the R3 top rated joint velocities.

SetJointVelLimit.remarks: The upper bound depends on the robot revision: 100 on a Meca500 R3, 150 on an R4. The wider bound is used here so that R4 programs are not flagged. Unlike SetJointVel, this acts as a ceiling rather than a target.

MoveJointsRel.description: Move every joint simultaneously by the given relative displacement.

MoveJointsVel.description: Move every joint simultaneously at the given joint velocity.

MoveLinRelTrf.description: Move the TRF along a linear path to a pose given relative to its current pose.

MoveLinRelWrf.description: Move the TRF along a linear path to a pose given relative to the WRF orientation at the current TCP position.

SetMoveDuration.description: Set the duration of every subsequent position-mode movement, in time-based move mode.

SetMoveMode.description: Select whether position-mode movements are timed by velocity or by duration.

SetCalibrationCfg.description: Enable or disable the robot's optional factory calibration.

SetSimModeCfg.description: Set the default simulation mode type used when ActivateSim is called without an argument.

SwitchToEtherCat.description: Enable EtherCAT and disable the other Ethernet-based protocols.

ActivateSim.description: Activate simulation mode, in which no hardware moves.

ConnectionWatchdog.description: Start or refresh the communication watchdog, or cancel it with a timeout of zero.

SetCtrlPortMonitoring.description: Enable or disable sending monitoring data over the control port.

SetEob.description: Enable or disable the end-of-block message.

SetEom.description: Enable or disable the end-of-movement message.

SetOfflineProgramLoop.description: Set whether the program being saved runs once or indefinitely.

SetRtc.description: Set the robot's internal real-time clock.

StopSaving.description: Save the program being recorded and stop saving.

TcpDumpStop.description: Stop a TCP dump before its timeout elapses.

GetCheckpointDiscarded.description: Return the id of the most recently discarded checkpoint.

GetTorqueLimits.description: Return the current joint torque thresholds.

GetRtAccelerometer.description: Return the acceleration measured by the accelerometer embedded in link 5.

GetRtConf.description: Return the current posture configuration, calculated from real-time data.

GetRtConfTurn.description: Return the current turn configuration, calculated from real-time data.

MoveGripper.description: Move the gripper fingers to the specified opening.

CreateVariable.description: Create a variable stored on the robot.

params.name: name
params.description: A unique name for the variable, optionally carrying dot-separated group prefixes (for example myGroup.mySubgroup.mainWrf).

params.name: value
params.description: The value to assign. Any basic JSON type: boolean, number, string or array, but not a JSON object.

params.name: cyclicId
params.description: The ID used to refer to this variable in cyclic protocols, or 0 for none.

params.name: override
params.description: How to behave when a variable of that name already exists.

params.name: volatile
params.description: Volatile (1), discarded on reboot, or persistent (0).

CreateVariable.remarks: Beta feature. Variable names are case-sensitive and may carry dot-separated prefixes. A cyclic ID must be in the range 10000 to 19999, or 0 for none; that is a range plus a special value, so it is documented here rather than enforced as bounds. JSON booleans must be lowercase.

DeleteVariable.description: Delete a variable from the robot.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable to delete.

GetVariable.description: Return the value of a robot variable.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable to read.

SetVariable.description: Change the value of an existing robot variable.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable to modify.

params.name: value
params.description: The new value. Any basic JSON type: boolean, number, string or array, but not a JSON object.

SetVariable.remarks: Beta feature. A variable's value can only be changed to a value of the same type; the robot performs no conversion. JSON booleans must be lowercase.
